name: appdev-ip-advisor
description: App-development IP issue-spotter AND app-store pre-submission policy reviewer for Claude Cowork. Two complementary surfaces: (1) IP triage — trademark / brand-name clearance, trade dress and visual-style mimicry (including UI elements copied from physical products like film-camera dials, rangefinder controls, hardware bezels), copyright (icons, fonts, music, sound effects, photography, code, AI-generated content), open-source license compliance (GPL/AGPL/MIT/Apache/BSL contagion), right of publicity / likeness / voice cloning, App Store / Play Store IP rules, AI Act labeling. (2) App-store policy review — pre-submission and rejection-triage across Apple App Store (iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / tvOS / visionOS / macOS), Google Play, Microsoft Store, Amazon Appstore, Samsung Galaxy Store, Huawei AppGallery, F-Droid, Flathub, Snap Store, Steam, Epic Games Store, and EU-DMA alternative iOS marketplaces — covering Apple privacy manifest + Required Reason APIs + App Privacy nutrition label, Google Play Data Safety form + Sensitive Permissions declarations + Android Vitals, Account Deletion in-app (Apple §5.1.1(v) / Play), IAP / Play Billing with DMA / Reader-app / User Choice Billing carve-outs, Generative AI app requirements, age ratings (IARC / ESRB / PEGI / USK), restricted categories (gambling / crypto / lending / health / kids / dating), Families / Kids policies (COPPA / GDPR-K / UK Children's Code), UGC moderation gates, listing metadata, notarisation and signing, F-Droid Anti-Features, Snap classic confinement, Sherlocked-feature risk, hardware-specific surfaces (visionOS / watchOS / CarPlay / tvOS / Wear OS / Android Auto / Galaxy DeX). App-development-specific complement to Anthropic's Claude for Legal `intellectual-property` plugin (which covers general IP practice but not the app-store / mobile / UI-mimicry / OSS-license / AI-content / privacy-manifest / Data-Safety / Account-Deletion / DMA / Kids-policy checklists app developers hit). Strongly recommends installing Claude for Legal alongside (Cowork → Customize → Browse plugins → Legal) so the plugin can prefer its MCP connectors: Westlaw / Practical Law for live trademark + copyright + AI-Act + GDPR + COPPA + UK Children's Code primary law; CourtListener for case-name lookups; Box / iManage / NetDocuments / Docusign / Google Drive as asset, release-candidate, and licence-bundle sources; Microsoft Word for tracked-change output on draft marketing copy, T&Cs, privacy policies, Account Deletion flow copy, and AI-content disclosure language. Declares `intellectual-property` as a soft dependency. Two Opus-pinned subagents (one per surface), three skills (appdev-ip-triage, appdev-app-store-rules, appdev-app-store-rejection-triage), two setup commands that wire Cowork Routines on the user's asset / spec / licence-bundle inbound folder and on the user's release-candidate folder respectively. Refuses to opine on software patents (registered patent attorney). Refuses IAP / DMA / Play Billing evasion advice. Produces issue lists, never verdicts; never predicts App Review pass/fail. Every output ends with a non-negotiable take-to-counsel or take-to-store-policy-review block. Not legal advice.
